title: Lesson 7. What files and folders are
description: Notebook and schoolbag, File Explorer and your own main folder

questions.prompt: Match the thing with its computer name
questions.explain: Files live in folders, folders in the computer-wardrobe.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a file?

questions.text: To change a folder's name: right-click → ___.

questions.prompt: File Explorer has main drawers: Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures.
questions.explain: They are on the left in File Explorer.

questions.prompt: How do you open a folder?

learn.intro: This is the most important part of the course! Today we learn where all your work lives on the computer.

slides.text: A notebook with something in it is called a **file** on a computer. A drawing is a file too. A song is a file. A cartoon is a file.
The schoolbag we put notebooks in is a **folder**. The whole computer is a big wardrobe with folder-drawers.
A notebook thrown anywhere can't be found later. So we sort everything into folders!

check.prompt: Is a drawing a file or a folder?
check.explain: A drawing is like a notebook — a file.

slides.text: Our wardrobe on the computer is **File Explorer** (the folder icon on the taskbar). On the left are the main drawers: Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures.
We go into Documents and come back with the **Back** button — the left arrow at the top.

check.prompt: In File Explorer you go back with the left arrow at the top.

slides.text: Make your own folder: open Documents → **right-click** an empty spot → **New → Folder** → type your name right away → **Enter**.
Too slow, and it still says "New folder"? Right-click the folder → **Rename** → name → Enter.

check.prompt: Put in order how to create a folder
